title: Splash, Shop and Slide
theme: Disney Springs, Typhoon Lagoon and Blizzard Beach
intro: [excited] Sunscreen on, shopping bags ready! Tonight we're skipping the castle and heading to Disney Springs, Typhoon Lagoon and Blizzard Beach. [laughs] Warning: some of these questions are slippery!

art.prompt: A sunny Florida panorama: a waterfront shopping district with a hot-air balloon overhead, a giant wave crashing in a tropical lagoon beneath a shipwrecked shrimp boat on a mountaintop, and a melting snow-capped mountain with ski lifts and water slides Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

categories.title: Making Waves on Screen
categories.intro: Water parks love a water movie. [chuckles] Dive into these splashy Disney films.

art.prompt: An underwater coral reef glowing with sunlight, a sea turtle shell silhouette in the current, a coconut-shell boat bobbing on the surface and a tiny snowflake drifting down from above Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: In Finding Nemo, this laid-back sea turtle surfs the East Australian Current. Typhoon Lagoon's water coaster is named for him.
clues.reveal: [laughs] The correct answer is Crush! Totally righteous, dude. His water coaster, Crush 'n' Gusher, opened at Typhoon Lagoon in 2005.

clues.clue: Frozen's snowman dreams of sunshine in this song. Good thing he never visited Blizzard Beach!
choices: Do You Want to Build a Snowman?
For the First Time in Forever
clues.reveal: The correct answer is In Summer! [chuckles] A snowman who loves heat. Olaf would melt right along with Blizzard Beach's story.

clues.clue: In Luca, sea monsters turn into humans whenever they get dry, then visit this Italian seaside town.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Portorosso! Gelato, Vespas and a pasta-eating triathlon. Silenzio, Bruno!

clues.clue: In Finding Nemo, the dentist's fish-tank gang is led by this scarred Moorish idol.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Gill! [whispers] He plans the great escape. Shark bait, ooh ha ha!

clues.clue: In Moana, these tiny pirates armor themselves in coconuts and attack on a fleet of boats.
clues.reveal: [gasps] The correct answer is the Kakamora! Small, cute, and absolutely terrifying. True Disney nerd points!

categories.title: Storm Surge Stories
categories.intro: Typhoon Lagoon opened in 1989, and its story says a storm blew everything into place. [laughs] Hang on to your swimsuit!

art.prompt: A tropical lagoon after a storm: a rusty shrimp boat impaled on the peak of a craggy mountain, surfboards stuck in palm trees, and a giant blue wave rolling across a huge pool Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: Typhoon Lagoon's giant wave pool is so big that guests have taken lessons there in this board sport.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is surfing! Typhoon Lagoon's wave pool is so big, guests have taken surfing lessons there. Cowabunga!

clues.clue: A shrimp boat named Miss Tilly is stuck on top of this mountain in the middle of Typhoon Lagoon.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Mount Mayday! [laughs] Mayday, mayday! Every so often Miss Tilly blasts water into the sky.

clues.clue: Typhoon Lagoon's water coaster uses jets of water to push rafts uphill. Name it.
clues.reveal: [gasps] The correct answer is Crush 'n' Gusher! Water coasters go UP. [laughs] Physics at the water park!

clues.clue: Typhoon Lagoon opened in this year, the same year as Disney-MGM Studios.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is 1989! [chuckles] A busy year at Walt Disney World. Pleasure Island opened that year too.

clues.clue: For years, this Typhoon Lagoon attraction let guests snorkel in a saltwater pool with tropical fish and small sharks.
clues.reveal: [impressed] The correct answer is Shark Reef! The saltwater snorkel pool is gone now. True water park nerd points!

categories.title: Snowmelt Summit
categories.intro: Blizzard Beach's story says a freak snowstorm hit Florida, a ski resort opened, and then everything melted into a water park. [laughs] Only in Florida!

art.prompt: A melting snowy mountain in tropical sunshine with icicles dripping, an empty ski chairlift climbing the slope, skis stuck in the snow and long water slides winding down to a pool Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: Blizzard Beach's theme is a melting version of this kind of winter vacation spot.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is a ski resort! Ski slopes in Florida melted into water slides. [laughs] Genius.

clues.clue: Water slides run down this mountain at the center of Blizzard Beach.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Mount Gushmore! [chuckles] Like Mount Rushmore, but much wetter.

clues.clue: Guests can ride this up Mount Gushmore, just like at a real ski resort.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is a chairlift! [laughs] Feet dangling over Florida. A ski resort classic.

clues.clue: This Blizzard Beach speed slide drops riders 120 feet from a ski jump at the top of the mountain.
clues.reveal: [gasps] The correct answer is Summit Plummet! It's one of the tallest free-fall speed slides anywhere. [whispers] Cross your arms and your ankles.

clues.clue: Blizzard Beach, which opened in 1995, has this cool mascot: a reptile wearing a scarf and ski cap.
clues.reveal: [impressed] The correct answer is Ice Gator! He's an alligator who loves the snow. True Disney nerd points!

categories.title: Springs Snapshots
categories.intro: Real photos from Disney Springs and its water parks. [chuckles] Tell me what you're looking at!

art.prompt: A sunny waterfront promenade with a vintage boat dock, a hot-air balloon tethered over a lake and shopping bags on a wooden bench Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: This soda brand's giant store at Disney Springs has a rooftop bar with drinks from around the world. Name the brand.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Coca-Cola! The store opened in 2015. [laughs] Go upstairs and taste sodas from around the world.

clues.clue: This tethered helium balloon carries guests up to 400 feet above Disney Springs. Name this type of ride.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is a balloon! It's the Aerophile balloon, and it's tethered to the ground. [laughs] Up, up and away!

clues.clue: At this Disney Springs restaurant, guests can ride in vintage Amphicars, cars that drive right into the lake.
clues.reveal: [gasps] The correct answer is the Boathouse! Amphicars are part car, part boat. [laughs] Floor it into the lagoon!

clues.clue: At which Disney water park can families ride Teamboat Springs, a long white-water raft ride for big groups?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Blizzard Beach! [chuckles] Teamboat Springs is a family raft ride, so the whole team spins down the mountain together.

clues.clue: The springs that gave Disney Springs its name bubble up in this central area of the district, between Marketplace and West Side.
clues.reveal: [impressed] The correct answer is Town Center! Its springs are part of the story behind the 2015 rename. True Springs scholar!

source.author: elisfkc from Orlando, FL, United States

categories.title: Before It Was Springs
categories.intro: Disney Springs has had a lot of names and a lot of lives. [whispers] Let's dig up some history.

art.prompt: A faded vintage postcard collage of a lakeside shopping village from the 1970s, a neon nightclub district and an old wooden water park dock overgrown with leaves Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: This Downtown Disney nightclub island famously celebrated New Year's Eve every single night.
clues.reveal: [laughs] The correct answer is Pleasure Island! Countdown, confetti and fireworks every night. Happy New Year... again!

clues.clue: From 1998 to 2017, this five-story indoor arcade at Downtown Disney let guests play video games and virtual-reality rides.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is DisneyQuest! [sighs] Fans still miss it. You could design your own roller coaster and then ride it in a simulator.

clues.clue: When it opened in 1975, the shopping area we now call Disney Springs was known by this name.
clues.reveal: [gasps] The correct answer is Lake Buena Vista Shopping Village! A little lakeside village that grew into a huge district.

clues.clue: Downtown Disney became Disney Springs in this year, after a big makeover.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is 2015! [chuckles] The new name came with new shops and dining. Then Town Center opened in 2016.

clues.clue: Before Typhoon Lagoon and Blizzard Beach, this was Walt Disney World's first water park. It opened in 1976 and closed in 2001.
clues.reveal: [impressed] The correct answer is River Country! A rustic swimming hole on Bay Lake. It never reopened after 2001. True Disney nerd points!
